<result>I read the two screens as a busy OrcaSlicer user setting up JusPrin for the first time.

## Screen 1: the import offer

**Line by line**

- **"JusPrin"** (logo, top left). This is the app's name.
- **"You got 500 free credits for signing up, good until 6 December."** I have a free allowance of something, and it runs out on 6 December.
- **"Signed in as alex@example.com"** I'm logged in with that address.
- **"Bring your printers from OrcaSlicer?"** It's offering to copy my OrcaSlicer printers into JusPrin.
- **"JusPrin copies these printers with their filaments and print settings. OrcaSlicer keeps its own copy."** The printers and their settings get copied, and nothing is taken away from OrcaSlicer.
- **Checkbox "Bambu Lab P1S 0.4 nozzle"**, **checkbox "Prusa MK4 0.4 nozzle"**, **checkbox "Creality K1C 0.4 nozzle"** (all ticked). These are the printers it found, and ticked ones get copied.
- **"Also brings 3 filaments and 2 print settings."** Three filament profiles and two quality profiles come along too.
- **"OrcaSlicer keeps these in ~/Library/Application Support/OrcaSlicer"** (folder icon). That's the folder it's copying from.
- **"JusPrin starts with Bambu Lab P1S 0.4 nozzle, the printer OrcaSlicer had selected."** After the import, the P1S will be my active printer.
- **Button "Import"** I expect this to copy the ticked printers and then show me a result.
- **"Other ways:"** followed by link **"Import from JusPrin 1…"**. I expect this to open a file picker or another dialog for importing from an older JusPrin.
- **Link "Choose my printer"** I expect this to skip the import and let me pick my printer model from a list.
- **Link "Back"** I expect this to return to the previous setup step.

**Where I'd hesitate**

- I own one printer, but three are listed and all are ticked. I'd wonder whether to untick the two I don't own, and whether leaving them ticked does any harm. Nothing says which printer is "mine".
- "Credits" isn't explained. I don't know what uses them, whether slicing or printing costs credits, or what happens after 6 December. That makes me a little uneasy before I've done anything.
- "Also brings 3 filaments and 2 print settings" doesn't name them. I can't tell whether my everyday PLA profile is included, and I can't choose.
- I don't know if the extras are tied to the printers. If I untick a printer, does the "3 filaments" count change?
- The folder path line is noise to me. I had to work out that "these" means OrcaSlicer's profiles. I'd also wonder whether it's a link, and why I'm being shown it at all.
- I can't tell what happens to the starting printer if I untick the P1S.
- "Import from JusPrin 1…" stopped me. I just installed JusPrin, so I'd wonder whether I missed an older version or should be using that path.
- "OrcaSlicer keeps its own copy" reassures me. It also makes me ask whether later changes in OrcaSlicer will sync over (I'd assume not).

## Screen 2: the import result

**Line by line**

- **"Imported from OrcaSlicer"** The import finished.
- **"Bambu Lab P1S 0.4 nozzle" / "Imported"**, **"Prusa MK4 0.4 nozzle" / "Imported"**, **"Creality K1C 0.4 nozzle" / "Imported"**, each with a check icon. All three printers came over.
- **"Also imported: 2 filaments (Generic PLA, Elegoo PETG) and 2 print settings (0.12mm Fine, 0.28mm Draft)."** These named profiles came over.
- **Warning icon, "1 filament wasn't imported. It stays in OrcaSlicer."** One filament profile failed, and the original is untouched.
- **Link "Show details"** I expect this to say which filament it was and why it failed.
- **Button "Continue"** I expect this to take me into the main app.

**Where I'd hesitate**

- Screen 1 promised 3 filaments and only 2 arrived. I'd click "Show details" before continuing, because the missing one might be the filament I actually use.
- The warning doesn't say whether I need to do anything about it.
- The only print settings are 0.12mm Fine and 0.28mm Draft. My normal 0.20mm profile isn't listed. I don't know if JusPrin has its own standard settings or if I'm stuck with Fine and Draft.
- Generic PLA is listed as "imported". I'd wonder why a stock profile needed importing, and whether only my custom profiles came over.
- This screen doesn't say which printer is active. Screen 1 said the P1S, but I'd want it confirmed here.
- Nothing says whether my printer's connection came over: the network link, the Bambu access code, sending jobs. I don't know if I can send a print or only export a file.
- Credits aren't mentioned again, so I still don't know if my first print costs anything.

## What I believe after these screens

I believe all three printers came over, plus two filaments (Generic PLA and Elegoo PETG) and two print settings (Fine and Draft). I believe OrcaSlicer is unchanged. One filament did not come over, and I don't know which one or why. I'd assume my everyday 0.20mm print setting didn't either. Before my first print I think I need to check that missing filament and pick a normal-quality setting. I'd also want to confirm the P1S is selected, and I'd be unsure whether JusPrin can send to the printer or whether that costs credits.</result>

## Every line and button

1. **"Import from OrcaSlicer"** (title). This window copies my OrcaSlicer setup into JusPrin.
2. **"×"** (top right). I expect this to close the window without importing anything, the same as Cancel.
3. **"JusPrin found 2 printers in OrcaSlicer that it doesn't have yet."** JusPrin looked at my OrcaSlicer setup and found two printers that it doesn't have.
4. **"When you import, JusPrin copies them with their filaments and print settings."** Importing a printer also brings over the filaments and print settings that go with it.
5. **"OrcaSlicer keeps its own copy."** Nothing is moved or deleted from OrcaSlicer, so it keeps working as before.
6. **"Bambu Lab P1S 0.4 nozzle"** (ticked checkbox). My P1S will be imported. I can untick it to skip it.
7. **"Prusa MK4 0.4 nozzle"** (ticked checkbox). My MK4 will be imported. I can untick it to skip it.
8. **"Bambu Lab A1 mini 0.4 nozzle"** with **"Already in JusPrin"** (grey, plain tick, no checkbox). JusPrin already has my A1 mini, so it won't import it again.
9. **"Generic PLA @Qidi"** with a **"+"** and **"New filament"**. This filament is in OrcaSlicer but not in JusPrin, and the "+" might add it.
10. **"Elegoo PETG"** with a **"+"** and **"New filament"**. Same as the line above, for Elegoo PETG.
11. **"OrcaSlicer keeps these in ~/Library/Application Support/OrcaSlicer"** (next to a monitor icon). This is the folder JusPrin read my OrcaSlicer setup from.
12. **"Choose another folder…"** (link). I expect this to let me point JusPrin at a different OrcaSlicer folder and scan it again.
13. **"Cancel"**. Closes the window and imports nothing.
14. **"Import 2 printers"** (main button). Copies the P1S and the MK4, along with their filaments and print settings, into JusPrin.

## Where I would hesitate

- **I can't tell whether the two filaments are included.** The printers have checkboxes, but the filaments only have a "+". That "+" looks like a button I have to click, not a sign that they're already coming along. The main button also says "2 printers" and doesn't mention filaments.
- **"Their filaments" doesn't match the list.** Are these two filaments everything that comes over, or are there others tied to the P1S and MK4 that aren't shown? And are these two tied to those printers at all?
- **"Generic PLA @Qidi" puzzles me.** I don't have a Qidi printer in this list, so why is a Qidi filament here? It took me a moment to recall that "@Qidi" is OrcaSlicer's way of naming the brand a profile was made for.
- **The print settings aren't listed anywhere.** I don't know how many of my print settings come over, or which ones. My tuned ones are what I care about most.
- **I worry the A1 mini import gets skipped entirely.** "Already in JusPrin" might mean my OrcaSlicer changes to the A1 mini, and its custom filaments and print settings, get ignored. Nothing says whether they merge.
- **"Doesn't have yet" is unclear.** Does it mean printers I haven't set up in JusPrin, or printers JusPrin doesn't support out of the box?
- **"Copies" suggests a one-time snapshot.** I assume later changes in OrcaSlicer won't follow me into JusPrin, but the window doesn't say so.
- **"These" in the folder line is vague,** and the path breaks across two lines. I also don't know when I'd need "Choose another folder…". Is it for a second OrcaSlicer install, or a backup?
- **Overwrites aren't covered.** If the names clash, could this replace a JusPrin preset I already have? And can I undo the import or remove what it added?
- **Other nozzles aren't mentioned.** Only 0.4 nozzle setups appear. If I have a 0.6 nozzle setup in OrcaSlicer, did JusPrin miss it?
- **Printer connections aren't mentioned.** Nothing says whether the network link to the printers comes over: the P1S access code or Bambu cloud sign-in, and the MK4's network address. So I don't know if I can send a print right away.

## What I expect from the main button

I expect the P1S and MK4 to arrive in JusPrin with some filaments and print settings, though I'm not sure the two listed filaments come along unless I click their "+". I expect the A1 mini and its OrcaSlicer changes not to come over, and nothing to change in OrcaSlicer. Before printing on the P1S or MK4, I'd expect to still connect each printer to JusPrin and check that my tuned print settings and filaments actually arrived.</result>

- **First launch:** "JusPrin copies these printers with their filaments and print settings."

- it wasn't sure what "JusPrin starts with <printer>…" means;
- the "Import from JusPrin 1…" link is cut off.

input.prompt:
You own a 3D printer and have been using OrcaSlicer. You just installed JusPrin, a desktop app that prepares 3D models for printing, and you're going through its first launch.

Look at these two screenshots, in this order (read each with the Read tool):
/private/tmp/claude/claude-502/-Users-kenneth-Projects-claude-cowork-wd/1d9cf17f-1e9f-4080-995a-64846419ce6d/scratchpad/cr9/screen-1.png
/private/tmp/claude/claude-502/-Users-kenneth-Projects-claude-cowork-wd/1d9cf17f-1e9f-4080-995a-64846419ce6d/scratchpad/cr9/screen-2.png

Screen 2 is what appears after you press the main button on screen 1. Don't look at any other file. For each screen:
1. Quote every line of text and every button exactly.
2. For each, say in one plain sentence what you take the line to mean, or what you expect the button to do.
3. List every place where you would hesitate, misread, worry, or not know what to do next, including information you'd want that the screen leaves out.

Read literally, like a busy newcomer. A line you had to puzzle out counts as a problem even if you worked it out. Finally, in two or three sentences: after these screens, what do you believe happened, and do you think you need to do anything before your first print?

<result>## Screen 1

**Quoted text and buttons, with what I take each to mean**

1. Logo: "JusPrin". This is the app I just installed.
2. "You got 500 free credits for signing up, good until 6 December." I have some free allowance that runs out on 6 December, but I can't tell what it pays for.
3. "Signed in as alex@example.com". This is the account I'm using.
4. "Bring your printers from OrcaSlicer?" JusPrin is offering to pull in my printer setups from OrcaSlicer.
5. "JusPrin copies these printers with their filaments and print settings. OrcaSlicer keeps its own copy." JusPrin will copy them, and nothing in OrcaSlicer will be changed or removed.
6. Checkbox (ticked): "Bambu Lab P1S 0.4 nozzle". This printer will be copied.
7. Checkbox (ticked): "Prusa MK4 0.4 nozzle". So will this one.
8. Checkbox (ticked): "Creality K1C 0.4 nozzle". And this one.
9. "Also brings 3 filaments and 2 print settings." Three filament profiles and two print-quality profiles come along too.
10. Folder icon with "OrcaSlicer keeps these in ~/Library/Application Support/OrcaSlicer". This is where JusPrin is reading OrcaSlicer's files from.
11. Button "Import". I expect it to copy the ticked printers and their extras.
12. "Other ways:" introduces the alternatives below.
13. Link "Import from JusPrin 1…". I expect it to bring settings from an older JusPrin, if I had one.
14. Link "Choose my printer". I expect it to let me skip the import and pick my printer from a list by hand.
15. Link "Back". I expect it to go to the previous step, probably sign-in.

**Where I'd hesitate**

- **Credits.** I don't know what a credit is or what uses them. I can't tell whether slicing or printing costs credits, or what happens after 6 December. The line also has nothing to do with the question this screen asks, so it pulls my attention away.
- **"OrcaSlicer keeps its own copy."** I had to stop and work this out. It ends up meaning OrcaSlicer is left untouched. It also makes me wonder whether the two copies stay in sync if I change something in OrcaSlicer later.
- **"with their filaments".** Are the filaments tied to particular printers? If I untick a printer, does that drop some of the three filaments?
- **"3 filaments and 2 print settings" are not named.** I can't decide whether I want them without knowing which ones they are. I also can't tell whether the count changes when I untick a printer.
- **The folder path line.** I can't tell why I'm being shown it, whether I need to act on it, or whether it's clickable. To a casual user it looks technical. If my OrcaSlicer data lives somewhere else, there's no way to point to it.
- **Which printers to keep ticked.** All three are ticked by default. If one is a printer I no longer own, the screen doesn't say whether leaving it ticked hurts anything.
- **Printer connection is not mentioned.** I can't tell whether this brings over the network link to my printer (the Bambu access code, the IP address) or only the slicing profiles. That decides whether I can send a print straight away.
- **"Import from JusPrin 1…"** I just installed JusPrin and didn't know a version 1 existed. I also can't tell whether the "…" means the text is cut off or that a dialog will open.
- **"Choose my printer" next to the import.** I can't tell whether these are either/or, or whether I can import now and add a printer by hand later.
- **"Back".** I don't know where it goes, or whether it signs me out.
- **No undo.** Nothing says whether I can remove imported items later or run the import again.

## Screen 2

**Quoted text and buttons, with what I take each to mean**

1. "Imported from OrcaSlicer". The copy finished.
2. "Bambu Lab P1S 0.4 nozzle" with "Imported" under it. This printer came over.
3. "Prusa MK4 0.4 nozzle" with "Imported". This one came over.
4. "Creality K1C 0.4 nozzle" with "Imported". This one came over.
5. "Also imported: 2 filaments (Generic PLA, Elegoo PETG) and 2 print settings (0.12mm Fine, 0.28mm Draft)." These are the extras that came over.
6. Warning icon with "1 filament wasn't imported. It stays in OrcaSlicer." One filament didn't make it, and it's still in OrcaSlicer.
7. Link "Show details". I expect it to show which filament was left out and why.
8. Button "Continue". I expect it to take me into the main app.

**Where I'd hesitate**

- **3 became 2.** Screen 1 promised 3 filaments and this screen says 2. I had to put that next to the warning to see they match.
- **The missing filament isn't named.** I have to click to find out whether it's the one I actually print with. That's the first thing I'd want to know.
- **No reason, no fix.** "It stays in OrcaSlicer" tells me nothing was lost. It doesn't tell me whether I can use that filament in JusPrin, whether I should recreate it, or how.
- **My everyday print setting seems to be missing.** I see 0.12mm Fine and 0.28mm Draft but no normal setting like 0.20mm Standard. I'd worry that my usual setting didn't come over. Nothing says whether JusPrin already has its own standard settings.
- **Unclear pairing.** Are Generic PLA and Elegoo PETG available on all three printers, or only some?
- **Still no word on the printer connection.** I can't tell whether JusPrin can actually reach my printers yet.
- **"Imported" under every row.** It repeats the heading. That's harmless, but I read three extra lines to learn nothing new.
- **"Continue" gives no hint of what comes next.** I don't know which printer will be selected, whether more setup follows, or whether I'll land on an empty workspace.
- **Credits are gone.** Screen 1 mentioned them and nothing has explained them since, so the question is still open.

## What I believe happened, and what's left

My understanding is that JusPrin copied my three printer profiles, two of my three filaments and two print settings from OrcaSlicer, and left OrcaSlicer itself untouched. Before my first print I'd feel I need to click "Show details" to find out which filament is missing. I'd also check that my everyday print setting exists in JusPrin, and confirm that JusPrin can actually connect and send to my printer. On top of that, I still don't know whether printing uses up my 500 credits.</result>

content.text:
You're right on both counts, and my earlier answer was wrong. The rule was removed: commit b0a2fe3b08, on 2026-11-06, deleted the "Landing a branch on jusprin-newui" section from AGENTS.md. Neither `jusprin-newui` nor `ui-walkthrough` has it today. I quoted the commit that added the rule without checking the current file.

**What the 22 commits cover** (the ones on `ui-walkthrough` that aren't on `jusprin-newui`). Almost all of it is the first-launch experience and what hangs off it:
- **First launch and importing printers (14 commits):** finding OrcaSlicer and JusPrin 1, the three ways to set up a printer, the import window and result screen, and today's wording.
- **Plan and billing (2 commits):** See prices on the welcome screen, the server's pricing pages in an in-app sheet, "+N credits" after buying, Delete account.
- **Account and sign-in (4 commits):** sign-in with the first-launch form everywhere, the Account box in Preferences, "No plan", and the Bring Your Own AI section in Preferences.
- **Design guideline notes (2 commits):** when to run the cold-reader check, and updating boards before code.

So squashing them into one commit makes sense. The simplest way is `git merge --squash ui-walkthrough` when landing on `jusprin-newui`. That makes one commit there without rewriting or force-pushing `ui-walkthrough`. Two things to know:
- **Timing:** the printer-setup session is still building the removal of the "JusPrin starts with…" line, so the squash should wait until that's pushed.
- **Branches will look unmerged:** git will show the session branches that went into `ui-walkthrough` as unmerged. That only matters if those sessions keep working on them.

`jusprin-newui` also has 2 newer commits, including the upstream-merge note. The squash merge brings those together with this work.

**Decision needed:** should I land `ui-walkthrough` on `jusprin-newui` as one squashed commit once the current build is pushed? It means running the tests on the result and pushing `jusprin-newui`, which is the branch everyone builds from. The other option is to wait, if more first-launch changes are coming. My pick is to land it once the build is in.
